details: The Financial Stability Board (FSB) warned that the $300 billion stablecoin market could experience redemption crises if reserves become inaccessible across borders during market stress. The FSB highlighted particular vulnerabilities in multi-issuer stablecoins, where demand might concentrate in one jurisdiction while reserve assets are held elsewhere, potentially transmitting stress into traditional financial markets.
title: Global Watchdog Warns Stablecoins Face Bank Run Risks

details: France's National Assembly Finance Committee adopted an amendment that would make gains from crypto-to-stablecoin swaps (specifically into MiCA-defined e-money tokens like USDC) taxable events starting January 1, 2027. This proposal aims to close a tax deferral loophole, recognizing gains before investors convert assets to fiat currency.
title: France Proposes Taxing Crypto-to-Stablecoin Swaps from 2027

details: US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) collectively experienced over $1.22 billion in net outflows in the week ending October 9, 2026. Bitcoin funds saw $681.1 million in withdrawals, while Ethereum ETFs lost $542.07 million, signaling a notable cooling in institutional demand. Fidelity's FBTC and Ark & 21Shares' ARKB were among the funds with significant outflows.
title: US Crypto ETFs See Over $1.2 Billion Outflow in One Week

details: Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has finalized rules for domestic spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs, which are set to launch on the Stock Exchange of Thailand from October 16. The new framework will initially prohibit retail investors from accessing foreign crypto ETFs and restrict securities firms from offering such products to non-institutional clients.
title: Thailand Finalizes Rules for Domestic Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs, Limits Foreign Funds

details: Ledger confirmed that some of its hardware wallet devices, particularly those sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis, contained unauthorized hardware implants. These implants are capable of capturing users' 24-word recovery phrases and transmitting them via an LTE network, leading to significant cryptocurrency losses. Ledger advises affected users to contact their support team and law enforcement.
title: Ledger Confirms Hardware Implant in Wallets Sold by Reseller

details: NFT marketplace Blur announced it will shut down its user-facing website, blur.io, on November 12, 2026, while its underlying on-chain protocol will remain operational. Additionally, Blur's Blend lending protocol will cease matching new loans on the same date. This decision follows a significant decline in NFT trading volume and has garnered varied reactions from the community.
title: Blur NFT Marketplace to Shut Down Frontend on November 12

details: Standard Chartered announced the launch of institutional custody services for Ripple USD (RLUSD), Ripple's stablecoin issued on the XRP Ledger (XRPL). This service, available through the bank's DIFC Branch, aims to expand bank-based stablecoin infrastructure and includes plans for integration with LMAX Group to enable RLUSD as eligible collateral for trading.
title: Standard Chartered Launches Institutional Custody for Ripple's RLUSD
